description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter for a spreadsheet-like grid interface in an Android application. The adapter manages cell rendering, including headers, and provides editing capabilities for individual cells through dialogs. It links to a SheetModel for data storage and updates.

classes.name: SpreadsheetGridAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter to display and edit a spreadsheet grid. Handles headers, cell rendering, and in-place editing.

classes.name: CellVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for a spreadsheet cell, holds a reference to a TextView displaying cell content.

methods.name: setSheet
methods.description: Updates the sheet data and recalculates display dimensions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the grid display without changing the sheet data.

methods.name: recalc
methods.description: Calculates the number of rows and columns to display, including headers.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new CellVH for the RecyclerView.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of cells to display, including headers.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to a cell view, setting text and handling clicks for editing.

methods.name: showEditDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to edit a cell's value and updates the sheet upon saving.

methods.name: toColumnLabel
methods.description: Converts a one-based column number to its corresponding Excel-like column label (A, B, ..., AA, etc.).
